brief: Final additional concept: modern technological and innovative, keeping the accepted immersive photographic direction
prompt:
Create a single realistic, production-quality UI mockup of a contemporary TECHNOLOGICAL AND INNOVATIVE homepage for the Kazakhstan company "КазПроф Лаб", kazproflab.kz.
Target dimensions: 1536 x 1024 pixels. Flat website screenshot only, no device frame, browser chrome, presentation canvas, concept label, multiple versions or watermark.
The attached image is a previous concept the user liked: an immersive laboratory background, readable text and clear service navigation. Use it as continuity for the company and professional quality, but create a genuinely new composition and new photograph, not just a recolor. This is the FINAL additional visual direction. The desired mood is precise, progressive, premium, technological, beautifully restrained.

BUSINESS TRUTH:
This is an expert consultancy for laboratory training, internal audits, preparation for accreditation, and management systems. Not an equipment vendor, medical clinic, testing laboratory, software platform, or accreditation authority. Do not claim AI products, digital monitoring, proprietary software, guaranteed accreditation, statistical performance, awards, client endorsements or certification. Convey innovation through art direction and visual precision, never through invented capabilities.

VISUAL CONCEPT:
A continuous deep-midnight-blue page #071425 with refined ice-white typography, electric-cyan #64E6F6 accents and one extremely subtle violet reflection in the photography. Keep the entire screen dark, with a slightly lighter navy service area below; don't switch to a white lower section.
The upper 65 percent is an exceptional wide photographic background of a real high-end analytical laboratory at blue hour: precise metal instruments, optical glass and laboratory vessels with realistic scale, illuminated interior architecture and deep perspective. A large elegant close-up of precision instrument details and crystal-clear laboratory glass occupies the right side; no giant person portraits. If people appear, only a small unobtrusive specialist in the far background. Photographic realism, incredible but believable material detail, cool daylight and soft cinematic reflection. No holographic equipment, no science-fiction machinery.
Blend the background photograph smoothly into a calm midnight-blue field on the left, so it remains one immersive edge-to-edge composition, not a photo boxed beside text. Let a single fine cyan architectural light trace or reflection travel through the right side along the lab perspective. A few very thin measurement ticks and ultra-faint technical grid lines around the image edges create precision; they must be decorative graphic marks without numbers, metrics, claims or data readouts. At most 5 percent of the visual weight. No random molecule icons, neon spheres, floating dashboard panels, crypto graphics, pseudo-code, HUD or radar circles.
Use a contemporary geometric sans-serif with beautiful Cyrillic, readable medium-weight body text and confident clear headline type. Strong deliberate whitespace and a rigorous grid. Clean boundaries, extremely subtle depth, restrained rounded corners. Avoid excessive glowing borders, glow around text, generic SaaS styling or aggressive gaming shapes.

LAYOUT AND EXACT RUSSIAN COPY:
Compact transparent header, plenty of air:
left typography-only "КазПроф Лаб";
center navigation "Услуги" "Обучение" "О компании" "Контакты";
right a fine cyan-outlined rounded-rectangle "Обсудить задачу" button. Header has no enclosing background box.
At left of the hero, a small technical-style but fully readable eyebrow:
"ОБУЧЕНИЕ · АУДИТ · КОНСАЛТИНГ"
Main headline in clean balanced lines:
"Экспертная поддержка вашей лаборатории"
Use a beautifully composed 64–76px headline; most of it white, the last phrase "вашей лаборатории" in pale ice-cyan. Never let the letters collide with photographic details.
Supporting text:
"Обучение, аудит и подготовка к аккредитации — с учётом задач вашей организации."
One unmistakable primary CTA: cyan fill, dark text "Получить консультацию" and a slim arrow; a quiet secondary "Направления работы" text link if composition allows.

LOWER SECTION:
In the lower 35 percent, a crisp slightly lighter deep-navy surface, with a restrained section heading "Компетенции, которые работают на вас".
Four spacious open service columns, or one integrated elegant translucent navy service strip with thin luminous hairline separators, not four heavy cards. Put small monospaced 01 02 03 04 indexes above each title, consistent with the technical direction.
Service names and short copy, exact:
"Обучение" — "Практические программы для специалистов"
"Подготовка к аккредитации" — "Сопровождение на нужном этапе"
"Аудит и оценка" — "Внутренние и диагностические аудиты"
"Системы менеджмента" — "Разработка и актуализация документов"
Readable ice-white titles, muted blue-gray descriptions, small cyan arrows. No large decorative icons.
At bottom, a discreet thin ruled row with "От вашей задачи — к понятному плану" on the left and "Обсудить проект ↗" on the right. If needed use three tiny text stages "Задача" / "План" / "Сопровождение", but avoid density.

QUALITY REQUIREMENTS:
The photograph and typography must feel custom art-directed, not an ordinary darkened stock banner. Deep rich photograph, controlled spectral light, exact alignment, tactile glass and metal, excellent contrast. An elegant real corporate website with a technological identity.
Use spacing and alignment before borders, no cards inside cards, no huge empty fields or crowded clusters. All text must render crisply in correct Cyrillic, no clipped text, no nonsense microcopy, no ambiguous overlapping controls. Body type 18–20px at this width. All photo imagery is illustrative.
The final image should feel recognizably more technological and innovative than the reference, with one coherent professional design.
